body_lead: THIRUVANANTHAPURAM: The Kerala Police on Tuesday launched an AI-enabled road accident prediction system and a cyber threat detection system aimed at improving road safety and strengthening cyber security. A third digital facility was also launched to coordinate police patrolling and other field activities. The cyber security system, named CyberWall, allows the public to check the authenticity of messages, web links and phone calls. People can verify URLs and phone numbers before making payments through websites or apps by checking them against the police repository.
